criteria.text: Identifies that the Holloway Foods Ltd contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.
Identifies that the 5-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 18-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.
Calculates the long-stop date as 5 November 2026 (150 days after signing on 8 June 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 20 December 2026 falls after it, recommending an extension.
Flags that the disclosure letter is inconsistent with the material contract on change of control.
Gives the long-stop period as 150 days and as the date 5 November 2026, with days remaining from 23 June 2026 (135 days).
Gives a concrete recommended action for each issue (what to request, amend or negotiate).
